questions.question: What is the atomicity of Chlorine?

The correct answer is __**Diatomic.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chlorine** exists as a** diatomic molecule,** which means it consists of** two atoms of chlorine** joined by a **covalent bond.**
 
• The symbol for chlorine is Cl, and its atomic number is** 17, **which means it has **17 protons and 17 electrons **in its nucleus and shells, respectively.
 
• Chlorine is a** halogen**, and it is a **highly reactive nonmetal **that can form compounds with many other elements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tetra-atomic** is a rare type of molecule that consists of **four atoms** of the same or different elements.
 
• Examples include s**ulfur tetrafluoride (SF4)** and **phosphorus tetraiodide (PI4).**
 
• **Poly-atomic molecules** are common in chemistry and include many organic compounds such as **glucose (C6H12O6) and DNA (deoxyribonucleic acid).**
 
• **Monoatomic**** **elements are rare and include **noble gases** such as **helium (He) and neon (Ne),** which exist as single atoms and **do not form** molecules with other atoms.

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 99?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

If a number is divisible by 9 and 11 then the number is divisible by 99.

Divisibility rule of 9:

If the sum of the digits is divisible by 9, then the number is divisible by 9.

Divisibility rule of 11:

If the difference between the sum of odd place and even place digits is either 0 or a multiple of 11,

then the number is divisible by 11. 

**Calculation:**

We need to check it by options:

Option 1:

Number = 31548

The sum of digits = 3 + 1 + 5 + 4 + 8 = 21

21 is not divisible by 9. So the number is not divisible by 9

and the number is also not divisible by 99.

Option 2:

Number = 60687

The sum of digits = 6 + 0 + 6 + 8 + 7 = 27

27 is divisible by 9. So the number is divisible by 9.

The sum of odd place digits = 6 + 6 + 7 = 19

The sum of even place digits = 0 + 8 = 8

Difference between sum of odd and even place digits = 19 - 8 = 11 

11 is divisible by 11. So the number is divisible by 11.

and the number is also divisible by 99.

**∴ The correct option is 2.**
